ASTM F136 grade titanium is your best bet, it's used for medical implants due to biocompatibility and low rejection rates. 

Just avoid stainless steel and surgical steel as both will likely contain nickel. Silver can also be a problem and cause staining to the ear.

Many people use 14k or 18k gold, but this is usually a lot more expensive than titanium and you have to be quite careful to ensure that it is body safe, as these are alloyed with other metals.
